question: For delivered orders, what is the correlation between delivery time in days (fractional) and review score?
sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_customer_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0 AS delivery_days,
        CAST(r.review_score AS DOUBLE) AS review_score
    FROM orders o
    JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
      AND r.review_score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CORR(delivery_days, review_score) AS delivery_review_correlation
FROM delivered
